Trace, implement and test: Octal To Decimal

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_Number_System;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class OctalToDecimal {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("enter the octal value:");
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        int decimal = 0;
        int pow = 0;
        for (int i = s.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int val = s.charAt(i) - '0';
            decimal += (val * Math.pow(8, pow));
            pow++;
        }
        System.out.println(decimal);
        sc.close();
    }
}
